sentences.en: Poetry is the expression of truth in metaphorical language.
sentences.zh: 诗歌是用隐喻的语言表达真理。

sentences.en: "Literally" can literally mean "metaphorically". "Literal" meaning "metaphorical" is also a literal irony.
sentences.zh: "literally" 有时确实意味着"隐喻地"。"literal" 的意思是"隐喻的"，这也是一种直白的讽刺。

sentences.en: Her smile was a metaphorical ray of sunshine.
sentences.zh: 她的笑容就像一道比喻性的阳光。

senses.zh: 隐喻般的;含有许多隐喻的
